name: Irie Soichiro
source: Soichiro works as a surgeon alongside Issei at Ebisu General Hospital. A people person, even the hospital director relies on and trusts him. He's been working at Ebisu for quite a while so if anyone is aware of the events of 12 years ago, it's him...
